property_summary: For every caller and msg.value, the reference contract only increases pot when exactly TICKET_AMOUNT (10) wei is sent; the mutant that removed the require can increase pot for other msg.value, so there exist fuzzed msg.value where pot (or address(c).balance) differs after play() between reference and mutant.
change_summary: Change the required ticket amount to allow any msg.value (remove the require), affecting when pot is updated and thus play observable outcomes.
